reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and it does most of what I need when I copy-paste things around. On 32,000 a year I can't add another 59 to 99 euros a month for something I'm not sure does more than what I already have.
objection: I don't have time to set it up and learn another tool, and I can't see what these 'AI co-workers' do that my ChatGPT subscription doesn't. And what is a 'credit' anyway? 100 a month could be nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it take a real chore off my plate in the first week, like answering customer emails from my own Gmail, with the onboarding done for me and a clear idea of what 100 credits actually buys.
